oracle.derivation: ngspice 44.2 run of the deck with ".options reltol=1e-6 abstol=1e-15 vntol=1e-9" added and the .tran line replaced by ".tran 0.1us 10us 0 0.1ns" (tmax 0.1 ns): 100196 accepted points, 52 LTE rejections, 0 Newton failures (counted on an instrumented 44.2 build). At the deck's own options ngspice cuts dt/8 on 718 Newton failures in the MOS2 slewing and its waveform sits up to 1.3e3x of tolerance (v(66)) off this one. Rows: the accepted point nearest each sample time of the original oracle (263 rows). Convergence: abstol=1e-12 moves every column by < 0.1x of tolerance except i(vb) (1.5x) and i(vin) (71x). i(vin) (the gate current of m10 through the pulse source) carries the trapezoid rule's undamped two-step ringing, +8.1e-8/-2.0e-7 A around the -5.8e-8 A that method=gear gives, so its values depend on the step phase at any tolerance.
oracle.command: ngspice -n -b -r reference.raw deck.sp  (deck + ".options reltol=1e-6 abstol=1e-15 vntol=1e-9", .tran -> ".tran 0.1us 10us 0 0.1ns")
